tr-qdms-v6.note: 12 Oct 2026: tr-qdms-v6 - qdms approve recomputes every row, record and task fingerprint from export.json and takes decisions only from the approvals files given (states in the export are not trusted); a file deciding a row two ways is refused; across files the latest decided_at holds, earlier decisions kept as history; decided_at needs a UTC offset; fingerprint values unchanged from v5

tr-qdms-v7.note: 12 Oct 2026: tr-qdms-v7 - review fixes: decided_at must be a date and time written out (no number/epoch) and not later than the run; row fingerprints also cover the entity as written, the impacted process and the layer, record fingerprints the entity as written and the layer (every fingerprint changes); a history decision no file makes is DECISION_NOT_IN_APPROVALS; an unreadable row is EXPORT_MODIFIED and load_export refuses an export its writers cannot read; modified_ids checks with the export's own department labels
